purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing - outpatient consultation fee (shinsatsu-ryou) automatic calculation and editing processing for medical receipt claims
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system and handles automatic generation and editing of outpatient consultation fees (shinsatsu-ryou) for medical billing. It processes various fee calculation rules including first-visit fees, re-visit fees, telephone re-visits, same-day re-visits, pediatric outpatient fees, rehabilitation fees, and various age/condition-based adjustments. The program has been updated through multiple revisions from 2002 to 2013 to accommodate Japanese medical fee schedule revisions.

notable_features: Large working-storage with many flag fields (FLG-* pattern)
25 COPY statements for shared data structures
27 CALL statements to other ORCA subprograms
342 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
Inline table initialization with VALUE clauses for fee codes
Japanese EUC-encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - file-less batch subprogram
Extensive revision history spanning 2002-2013 in comments
Multiple occurrence tables for rehabilitation date tracking
verdict.notes: Comments are encoded in Japanese EUC-JP but decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake display. The program is clearly part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system used widely in Japanese clinics. File name suffix '201307' likely indicates the July 2013 fee schedule revision version. The program is a subprogram (no file I/O defined, called by higher-level ORCA components).
